SELECT TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456', 'not/a-zone') AS r
SELECT CONVERT_TIMEZONE('not/a-zone', 'UTC', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456') AS r

SELECT TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456', '+05:30:15') AS r0, FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456', '+05:30:15') AS r1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('+05:30:15', 'UTC', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456') AS r2, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', '+05:30:15', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456') AS r3

SELECT TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456', '-00:30:15') AS r0, FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456', '-00:30:15') AS r1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('-00:30:15', 'UTC', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456') AS r2, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', '-00:30:15', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2024-01-02 13:04:05.123456') AS r3
